title: Retrieval And Grounding
description: Search, citations, refusals, and eval of grounded answers.

levels.name: Foundation
levels.description: Can retrieve chunks for a question, attach a citation to retrieved text, and refuse when the store has no support — under written guidance.

levels.name: Apprentice
levels.description: Can write an eval set before tuning, justify chunk size in a short note, and show a refusal on a question outside the store.

levels.name: Practitioner
levels.description: Can independently evaluate grounded answers as supported, unsupported or refused, keep citations pointing at retrieved text not model memory, and tune only after the eval set is frozen.

levels.name: Journeyman
levels.description: Can diagnose an answer that cites the model's memory, a chunk size that splits a needed fact, or an eval written after seeing retrieval, and produce a case set another engineer can rerun.

levels.name: Mastery Evidence
levels.description: Can review another apprentice's retrieval harness, name a citation that does not appear in the store or a missing refusal, and teach when to refuse on an unfamiliar corpus.
